about_pullquote: We started in a van because we hated being let down by unreliable engineers.
about_para_1: AC Ventilation & Electricals was founded in Newcastle in 2006 by two experienced engineers frustrated by the lack of trustworthy air con support. Over nearly two decades, we've grown from a two-man outfit to a team of eight fully trained technicians, completing over 2,000 repairs, installations and services across Tyne & Wear. Every engineer carries diagnostic equipment and parts, so most jobs finish on the first visit.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on honesty. We tell you upfront what's wrong, what it costs to fix, and whether repair or replacement makes sense. Repeat customers make up 60% of our work — that says more than any award. We're Gas-Safe trained for refrigerant handling and hold full electrical certification, so you can trust us with both the cooling and the wiring.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Air con packed up mid-heatwave. Called first thing Monday morning and they were here by lunchtime. Fixed a leaking joint, recharged the system, and it's been perfect since. Honest blokes, fair prices, no faffing about.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a new unit installed in our office. The engineer explained everything, tested it properly, left it spotless. Brilliant job. They came back a year later for the service without being asked — that's the kind of outfit you want.
reviews.author: Lisa H.

reviews.text: My compressor was shot. Rather than sell me a new system, they sourced a replacement part and fitted it. Saved me nearly £1,500. Can't fault their integrity. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David P.
